name: shield-kya
description: Know Your Agent: fail-closed eval (ALLOW | DENY | REQUIRE_APPROVE), dual-plane host=ide|runtime, human approval. This plugin is a thin MCP gate — the control plane is the sole PEP.

KYA_API_KEY.title: API key
KYA_API_KEY.description: Control-plane API key. Required when the plane enforces auth.

KYA_HOST.title: Host plane
KYA_HOST.description: ide = authoring / dry-run. runtime = production work.

KYA_AGENT_ID.title: Agent id
KYA_AGENT_ID.description: Registered agent principal id on the control plane.
